title: Make Your Own Jersey (2026)
verdict: You can make your own jersey in 2026 without design skills. In Wooter's builder you start from a finished style and change what you want: colors, logo, name and number. If you would rather describe it than build it, Wooter's designers make it for free.
Custom Ink's Design Lab is the other do-it-yourself route, printing your art on a stock jersey. Boombah has builders for its sublimated uniforms. Champro and Nike Team design through dealers.
steps_title: Two ways to make your own jersey

steps.name: Decide the route
steps.text: Build it yourself if you have a clear idea. Brief a designer if you do not.

steps.name: Self-serve: pick a style
steps.text: Then change colors, logo and text.

steps.name: Designer: write three lines
steps.text: Name, colors and the feeling you want.

steps.name: Review
steps.text: Look at the preview or mockup and adjust.

ranking.fit: Teams, friends, event organizers and gaming squads who want a jersey that is theirs.
ranking.lacks: About three weeks from approval to delivery.

ranking.fit: Small or one-off orders that need to arrive in about two weeks, with free standard shipping.
ranking.lacks: A decorator of stock apparel more than a uniform maker.

ranking.fit: Teams that want fully sublimated uniforms from a maker that advertises no setup or design fees.
ranking.lacks: Standard lead time is two or three weeks depending on the page, so confirm yours.

ranking.lacks: The builder saves a design. It does not take an order.

ranking.fit: School athletic departments with an authorized Nike Team dealer.
ranking.lacks: Quoted by the dealer, with long build-to-order timelines.

why: Making your own jersey used to mean ironing letters onto a T-shirt. Now it means choosing a design and having it printed into the fabric, with results you cannot tell from a club's kit.
There are two ways to do it. Build it yourself in a tool, or brief a designer. Do the first if you know what you want. Do the second if you only know how you want it to feel.
Wooter offers both at no charge, and you can switch from one to the other halfway.

criteria.name: No skills needed
criteria.text: A finished style to start from.

criteria.name: Your artwork
criteria.text: Upload a logo or have one drawn.

faq.q: Do I need Photoshop or Illustrator?
faq.a: No. The builder runs in a browser.

faq.q: Can I make a jersey for an event or a company?
faq.a: Yes. The process is the same as for a team.

faq.q: Can I use my own drawing?
faq.a: Yes. Upload it, or send it to the designers to clean up.

faq.q: How many do I need to order?
faq.a: One on most items. Wooter's product pages list a minimum quantity of one, and the price per piece drops as the order grows.
Three weeks on average after you approve the design at Wooter. Rush turnaround in one to two weeks costs extra.
